title: SWE Data Construction, Automatically!
authors_zh: Lianghong Guo、Yanlin Wang、Caihua Li、Wei Tao、Pengyu Yang、Jiachi Chen、Haoyu Song、Duyu Tang、Zibin Zheng
paper_type_zh: 软件工程任务与 agent 轨迹自动构建、环境验证及开放发布
best_for_zh: 研究 GitHub issue 数据构建、repository-agent SFT、程序化环境 verifier，以及容器、谱系、污染和权利审计
one_line: SWE-Factory converts issue and pull-request pairs into runnable coding-agent tasks through binary-test recovery, four-agent Docker and test-script generation, execution feedback, and gold-patch fail-to-pass validation, then samples Kimi-K2 trajectories for supervised fine-tuning.
SWE-Factory 以四代理生成 Dockerfile 与评测脚本，并用 gold-patch fail-to-pass 退出码契约验证 issue-resolution 环境；它公开 671 条任务、2,809 条 messages-only 轨迹和 430 条 Gym 记录，但三者缺少逐行谱系与不可变环境绑定。
why: It demonstrates a bridge from real software changes to executable agent supervision while showing why verifier semantics, immutable containers, source rights, contamination checks, and row-level release lineage are part of data quality rather than optional documentation.
inclusion_reason: SWE-Factory is a central open construction recipe for turning real GitHub issue and pull-request pairs into executable Docker-based tasks, verifying them with a gold-patch fail-to-pass contract, collecting coding-agent trajectories, and using those trajectories for full-parameter SFT. It also exposes audit boundaries around exit-code semantics, gold-label dependence, container immutability, record-set reconciliation, version drift, contamination, and upstream rights.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The FSE 2026 Research Papers record accepts this work as SWE Data Construction, Automatically! Its system name is SWE-Factory. The accepted title and author list should control the Card; the older arXiv/repository citation title, SWE-Factory: Your Automated Factory for Issue Resolution Training Data and Evaluation Benchmarks, belongs to an earlier identity surface that used Yingtian Zou where the accepted version lists Haoyu Song. Headline results also changed across versions: the accepted record reports 337 valid environments from 671 issues with GPT-4.1 mini at $0.047 per instance. No final ACM DOI or proceedings BibTeX is verified.

GitHub issue-resolution datasets are not reusable from issue text and merged code alone. An executable task also needs a base commit, complete test resources, dependencies, a Docker environment, an evaluation script, and a terminal predicate that says whether the original repository state fails and the gold patch passes. Existing collection pipelines can omit binary test-file content, require manual environment engineering, and need project-specific log parsers.

SWE-Factory is in the Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track because it connects the full construction chain: issue/pull-request pairing, binary test-resource repair, multi-agent environment generation, execution-grounded refinement, programmatic fail-to-pass validation, trajectory collection, SFT, and artifact release. It is not evidence for preference learning or online RL, and benchmark improvement does not by itself certify the released data.

The release exposes three non-equivalent data objects. The pinned repository contains 671 raw SweSetupBench rows with repository, pull request, base commit, issue text, gold patch, and test patch. The primary Hugging Face release contains 2,809 Kimi-K2 interaction rows whose public schema is only messages. The later SWE-Factory-Gym release contains 430 task/environment rows with repository fields, patches, Dockerfile, and evaluation scripts. Their missing cross-release mapping is a central L4 audit boundary.

FSE 2026 Research Papers 官方记录以 SWE Data Construction, Automatically! 接收本文，系统名为 SWE-Factory。本 Card 以 accepted title 与 accepted author list 为主体身份；较早的 arXiv/仓库引用标题 SWE-Factory: Your Automated Factory for Issue Resolution Training Data and Evaluation Benchmarks 属于旧身份界面，其中 Yingtian Zou 在 accepted version 中被 Haoyu Song 替换。不同版本的 headline result 也发生变化：accepted record 报告 GPT-4.1 mini 在 671 个 issue 上构建 337 个有效环境，单实例成本 $0.047。最终 ACM DOI 与 proceedings BibTeX 尚未核验。

GitHub issue-resolution 数据不能只靠 issue text 和 merged code 复用。一个可执行任务还需要 base commit、完整 test resource、dependency、Docker environment、evaluation script，以及判断原始状态失败而 gold patch 通过的 terminal predicate。现有构建流程可能遗漏 binary test file 内容，需要人工配置环境，并依赖项目特定日志解析器。

SWE-Factory 属于“数据构建与开放发布配方”轨道，因为它连接完整构建链：issue/pull-request pairing、binary test-resource repair、多代理环境生成、execution-grounded refinement、程序化 fail-to-pass 验证、trajectory collection、SFT 与工件发布。它不是 preference learning 或 online RL 的证据，benchmark improvement 本身也不能认证发布数据质量。

发布内容包含三个不等价数据对象。固定 revision 的仓库提供 671 条 raw SweSetupBench 记录，含 repository、pull request、base commit、issue text、gold patch 与 test patch。主要 Hugging Face 发布含 2,809 条 Kimi-K2 交互记录，公开 schema 只有 messages。后续 SWE-Factory-Gym 发布含 430 条 task/environment 记录，带 repository 字段、patch、Dockerfile 与 evaluation script。三者之间缺少逐行映射，是本 L4 Card 的核心审计边界。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SWE-Factory automates the path from a real issue and merged pull request to an executable coding-agent task: recover omitted binary test resources, have four agents construct and debug the environment, and accept the task only when a gold-patch fail-to-pass check succeeds.

The four SWE-Builder roles separate responsibilities. Repository Explorer retrieves setup and testing context. Environment Manager writes the Dockerfile. Test Manager writes the evaluation script. Test Analyst builds the image, starts the container, runs evaluation, and returns execution evidence for refinement. Successful Dockerfile/script pairs enter a memory pool; a later task retrieves the closest earlier version from the same repository. The memory stores recipes, not immutable built images.

The feedback contract is environmental and programmatic. An evaluation script applies the test patch, captures the test command status, and emits OMNIGRIL_EXIT_CODE. A task is valid only when the relevant tests return nonzero before the gold patch and zero after it; missing markers are errors. This observes execution status but not the semantics of the failure: a crash, dependency error, timeout, or assertion failure can all be nonzero. Gold-patch validation is also label-aware, so incorrect issue/PR linkage, tests, or gold patches can propagate into acceptance.

Relative to SWE-bench-style manual environment construction and SWE-Gym's semi-manual repository setup, the concrete change is automated environment-recipe production plus a standardized exit-code parser. Binary-resource recovery, multi-agent role decomposition, execution feedback, and same-repository/version memory are integrated into the construction loop. Unit tests, Docker, gold patches, and SFT are established components; the contribution is their automation and packaging into a reproducible-looking but still partially released lifecycle.

SWE-Factory 自动完成从真实 issue 与 merged pull request 到可执行 coding-agent task 的转换：恢复缺失的 binary test resource，由四个代理构建并调试环境，并且仅在 gold-patch fail-to-pass 检查成功时接收任务。

SWE-Builder 的四个角色职责分离。Repository Explorer 检索 setup 与 testing context；Environment Manager 编写 Dockerfile；Test Manager 编写 evaluation script；Test Analyst 构建 image、启动 container、运行评测，并返回执行证据用于迭代修正。成功的 Dockerfile/script pair 进入 memory pool，后续任务检索同仓库最接近的历史 version。该 memory 保存的是配方，而不是不可变 built image。

反馈契约同时具有环境性与程序性。Evaluation script 应用 test patch，捕获测试命令状态并输出 OMNIGRIL_EXIT_CODE。只有相关测试在 gold patch 前返回非零、应用 gold patch 后返回零时，任务才有效；缺少 marker 视为错误。该机制能观察执行状态，却不能识别失败语义：crash、dependency error、timeout 或 assertion failure 都可能是非零。Gold-patch validation 还具有 label-aware 特征，因此错误的 issue/PR linkage、test 或 gold patch 可能进入接收结果。

相对于 SWE-bench 风格的人工环境构建和 SWE-Gym 的半人工仓库配置，本文的具体变化是自动生成环境配方并使用标准化 exit-code parser。Binary-resource recovery、多代理角色分工、execution feedback 与同仓库/version memory 被集成到构建闭环。Unit test、Docker、gold patch 与 SFT 并非新组件；贡献在于将它们自动化并封装为一条表面可复现、实际仍为部分发布的数据生命周期。

title: Method
方法
html:
The paper's benchmark pool begins with 2,441 GitHub issues from 12 repositories in Python, Java, JavaScript, and TypeScript, limited to issues created before 2025-03-01. Each issue is paired with a merged pull request; pairs without test changes are discarded. Within each repository/version stratum, 20% is sampled with a minimum of one, producing 671 SweSetupBench tasks. Collection repairs binary resources that GitHub diffs omit by generating direct-download commands and removing incomplete binary hunks before evaluation.

For each task, SWE-Builder runs Repository Explorer, Environment Manager, Test Manager, and Test Analyst. The first three gather context and propose a Dockerfile/evaluation script; Test Analyst uses build_image, start_container, and run_eval to supply execution feedback. A successful pair is stored for same-repository/version retrieval. Accepted-paper experiments use GPT-4.1-mini-2025-04-14, Kimi-K2, or DeepSeek-V3-0324 at temperature 0.1, up to five Builder iterations, ten context-retrieval rounds, and 20 parallel subprocesses.

Filtering is gold-patch fail-to-pass. The evaluation script must save the test exit status and emit the standardized marker. The original state plus test patch must be nonzero; after applying the gold patch it must be zero. No learned reward model is involved. Three experienced researchers inspect logs to evaluate the parser, but their record-level annotations, disagreements, adjudication, and corrections are not released.

For training, GPT-4.1 mini constructs 2,877 Python environments from ten repositories stated to be distinct from SWE-bench; tool installation succeeds for 2,809. Kimi-K2 samples one trajectory per prepared task at temperature 0.2 with at most 40 interactions using DeepSWE's Execute Bash, Search, File Editor, and Finish/Submit tools. The public 2,809-row train split serializes these episodes only as interleaved messages; it does not expose task ID, Dockerfile, evaluation script, verifier outcome, reward, or success.

Five models—Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct 3B/7B/14B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and non-thinking Qwen3-8B-Instruct—receive full-parameter SFT with MS-Swift. The paper states eight A800 GPUs, three training iterations, maximum length 65,536, bf16, learning rate 1e-5, warmup 0.05, FlashAttention, packing, YaRN, and model-dependent sequence parallelism. Evaluation uses vLLM on one A100 with temperature 0 and up to 40 agent iterations on SWE-bench Verified and Lite.

Reproduction must pin the accepted-paper PDF, repository commit, Hugging Face revisions, prompts, Builder model and budget, task membership, Dockerfiles, base-image digests, package locks, evaluation scripts, and trajectory/checkpoint mapping. The linked Appendix.pdf is absent, the repository has no paper-run tag, and current README/run examples use different temperature and parallelism values.

论文的 benchmark pool 从 12 个 Python、Java、JavaScript 与 TypeScript 仓库中的 2,441 个 GitHub issue 开始，只保留 2025-03-01 之前创建的 issue。每个 issue 与 merged pull request 配对，不含 test change 的 pair 被丢弃；在每个 repository/version stratum 内按 20% 采样且至少取一条，得到 671 个 SweSetupBench task。构建流程通过生成 direct-download command 并在评测前移除不完整 binary hunk，修复 GitHub diff 遗漏的 binary resource。

对每个任务，SWE-Builder 运行 Repository Explorer、Environment Manager、Test Manager 与 Test Analyst。前三个角色收集 context 并生成 Dockerfile/evaluation script；Test Analyst 使用 build_image、start_container 和 run_eval 提供 execution feedback。成功的 pair 被保存，用于同 repository/version 检索。Accepted-paper 实验使用 GPT-4.1-mini-2025-04-14、Kimi-K2 或 DeepSeek-V3-0324，temperature 0.1，最多五轮 Builder iteration、十轮 context retrieval 与 20 个并行 subprocess。

过滤依据是 gold-patch fail-to-pass。Evaluation script 必须保存测试 exit status 并输出标准 marker。原始状态加 test patch 必须返回非零，应用 gold patch 后必须返回零；流程不训练 learned reward model。三名有经验研究者检查日志以评估 parser，但逐条 annotation、disagreement、adjudication 与 correction 未发布。

训练阶段，GPT-4.1 mini 从十个据称与 SWE-bench 仓库不同的 Python 仓库构建 2,877 个环境，其中 2,809 个完成工具安装。Kimi-K2 对每个 prepared task 以 temperature 0.2、最多 40 次交互采样一条轨迹，使用 DeepSWE 的 Execute Bash、Search、File Editor 与 Finish/Submit 工具。公开 2,809 行 train split 只把 episode 序列化为交错 messages，不含 task ID、Dockerfile、evaluation script、verifier outcome、reward 或 success。

五个模型——Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct 3B/7B/14B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 non-thinking Qwen3-8B-Instruct——使用 MS-Swift 做 full-parameter SFT。论文报告八张 A800、三次 training iteration、maximum length 65,536、bf16、learning rate 1e-5、warmup 0.05、FlashAttention、packing、YaRN 与按模型设置的 sequence parallelism。评测使用单张 A100 与 vLLM，temperature 0，最多 40 次 agent iteration，在 SWE-bench Verified 与 Lite 上运行。

复现时必须固定 accepted-paper PDF、repository commit、Hugging Face revision、prompt、Builder model 与 budget、task membership、Dockerfile、base-image digest、package lock、evaluation script，以及 trajectory/checkpoint mapping。链接的 Appendix.pdf 缺失，仓库没有 paper-run tag，当前 README/run example 的 temperature 与 parallelism 也不同于 accepted paper。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On the 671-task benchmark, the accepted paper reports that GPT-4.1 mini produces 435 outputs and 337 fail-to-pass-valid environments at $0.047 and 26.3 minutes per issue. Kimi-K2 produces 424 outputs and 321 valid environments at $0.056 and 30.2 minutes; DeepSeek-V3 produces 358 outputs and 282 valid environments at $0.037 and 23.0 minutes. These are construction yield and cost results under the reported configuration, not per-record release verification.

Two ablations identify necessary components. On 44 tasks with binary test resources, all three Builder models fall to zero fail-to-pass cases when binary-file downloading is disabled. Without execution feedback, valid counts fall to 2/671 for GPT-4.1 mini, 18/671 for Kimi-K2, and 5/671 for DeepSeek-V3. The evidence supports binary recovery and execution feedback within this benchmark; it does not isolate every agent role or guarantee transfer to other languages and build systems.

The exit-code parser is evaluated on 1,217 constructed instances, of which 1,201 provide usable before/after log pairs. Human review yields TP=923, FP=0, TN=262, and FN=16: precision 1.00, recall 0.983, and F1 0.991. Four false negatives come from marker identifier typos and 12 from set -e early termination. This is strong parser evidence, but the annotations and corrected record IDs are unavailable, and nonzero-before still admits error-to-pass.

The model study reports improvement for all five SFT models. Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct rises from 5.8% to 21.0% resolve rate on SWE-bench Verified. This result shows that the reported task/trajectory/SFT combination can be useful; it does not prove that every one of the 2,809 trajectories is successful, correctly linked, uncontaminated, reproducible, or legally reusable.

在 671 个任务的 benchmark 上，accepted paper 报告 GPT-4.1 mini 产生 435 个 output，其中 337 个环境通过 fail-to-pass，单 issue 成本 $0.047、耗时 26.3 分钟。Kimi-K2 产生 424 个 output、321 个有效环境，成本 $0.056、耗时 30.2 分钟；DeepSeek-V3 产生 358 个 output、282 个有效环境，成本 $0.037、耗时 23.0 分钟。这些是报告配置下的构建产率与成本结果，不是逐条 release verification。

两组消融说明关键组件的作用。在 44 个包含 binary test resource 的任务上，禁用 binary-file downloading 后，三个 Builder model 的 fail-to-pass 数量都降为零。移除 execution feedback 后，有效数量分别降至 GPT-4.1 mini 的 2/671、Kimi-K2 的 18/671 与 DeepSeek-V3 的 5/671。证据支持 binary recovery 与 execution feedback 在本 benchmark 中的作用，但没有单独隔离每个代理角色，也不能保证迁移到其他语言与 build system。

Exit-code parser 在 1,217 个构建实例上评估，其中 1,201 个提供可用 before/after log pair。人工检查得到 TP=923、FP=0、TN=262、FN=16，即 precision 1.00、recall 0.983、F1 0.991。四个 false negative 来自 marker identifier typo，另 12 个来自 set -e 提前终止。这是较强的 parser 证据，但 annotation 与更正后的 record ID 未公开，而且 nonzero-before 仍存在 error-to-pass 风险。

模型实验报告五个 SFT model 都有提升。Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct 在 SWE-bench Verified 上的 resolve rate 从 5.8% 升至 21.0%。该结果说明报告的 task/trajectory/SFT 组合可能有用，但不能证明 2,809 条 trajectory 全部成功、链接正确、无污染、可复现或可合法复用。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest construction baseline is the SWE-bench family: issue/pull-request extraction, repository checkout, environment setup, and gold-patch fail-to-pass validation already exist, but environment engineering and log interpretation require substantial manual work. SWE-Gym likewise packages executable software-engineering tasks and trajectories, using semi-manual dependency configuration.

SWE-Factory changes the construction interface in three concrete ways. It repairs binary test resources omitted by GitHub diffs; it assigns repository exploration, Dockerfile writing, evaluation-script writing, and execution analysis to four collaborating agents; and it standardizes test-status extraction around an exit-code marker. Execution feedback and retrieval of a successful same-repository/version recipe make environment construction iterative rather than one-shot.

The new data object is not merely an issue-patch pair: it links source task fields, an executable environment recipe, a fail-to-pass decision, and a full tool-interaction episode intended for SFT. The quality signal attaches to environment acceptance, not to individual reasoning steps. Public trajectory rows do not carry that signal, so the release does not provide process labels or auditable trajectory-level rewards.

The novelty is automation and lifecycle integration, not a new testing semantics, Docker substrate, SFT objective, or independent verifier. Scaling from 671 benchmark tasks to 2,809 training trajectories is useful engineering evidence, but the absent Appendix, row mappings, immutable images, and release manifest prevent the open artifacts from fully instantiating the paper's claimed end-to-end object.

最接近的构建基线是 SWE-bench 系列：issue/pull-request extraction、repository checkout、environment setup 与 gold-patch fail-to-pass validation 已经存在，但环境工程与日志解释需要大量人工工作。SWE-Gym 同样封装可执行软件工程任务与轨迹，但采用半人工 dependency configuration。

SWE-Factory 从三个具体方面改变构建接口。它修复 GitHub diff 遗漏的 binary test resource；把 repository exploration、Dockerfile 编写、evaluation-script 编写与 execution analysis 分配给四个协作代理；并围绕 exit-code marker 标准化 test-status extraction。Execution feedback 与同 repository/version 成功配方检索，使环境构建成为迭代过程，而不是 one-shot generation。

新的数据对象不只是 issue-patch pair，而是连接 source task 字段、可执行 environment recipe、fail-to-pass decision 与用于 SFT 的完整 tool-interaction episode。Quality signal 附着在环境接收结果上，而不是单个 reasoning step 上。公开 trajectory row 不携带这一信号，因此发布内容不提供 process label 或可审计的 trajectory-level reward。

新意是自动化与生命周期集成，而不是新的 testing semantics、Docker substrate、SFT objective 或独立 verifier。从 671 个 benchmark task 扩展到 2,809 条训练 trajectory 提供了工程证据，但缺失的 Appendix、逐行 mapping、immutable image 与 release manifest 使公开工件尚未完整实现论文所声称的端到端数据对象。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The open objects do not reconcile. The repository has 671 raw SweSetupBench rows, the paper describes 2,877 constructed and 2,809 prepared Python environments, the primary trajectory dataset has 2,809 messages-only rows, and SWE-Factory-Gym has 430 task/environment rows. No stable IDs or manifest map these sets to training subsets, five checkpoints, or evaluation predictions. Success, verifier output, reward, and rejected records are absent from the primary trajectory schema.

The verifier can be both false-negative and semantically over-permissive. Marker typos and set -e caused 16 reported false negatives. Conversely, any nonzero pre-patch exit can satisfy the first half of the predicate, including crashes, missing dependencies, and timeouts; the reported parser confusion matrix does not prove that every nonzero represents the intended failing test. Because the gold patch is used for acceptance, source linkage and gold-label errors are not independently caught.

Environment reproduction is incomplete. Dockerfiles and evaluation scripts are recipes, not immutable environments. Base-image tags can move, and the release lacks built images, digest-pinned bases, package locks, binary-resource hashes, SBOMs, build logs, and a task-wide mapping from every episode to its exact container. The missing Appendix.pdf, absent paper-run tag, and drift between accepted settings and current examples further weaken reconstruction.

Identity and citation surfaces drift. The accepted paper is SWE Data Construction, Automatically! and lists Haoyu Song; older arXiv/repository citation metadata uses the longer SWE-Factory title and Yingtian Zou. The accepted PDF still contains placeholder 2018 ACM metadata, a dummy DOI, and Trovato et al. headers. Until an official proceedings record is available, an ACM URL, DOI, page range, and final BibTeX remain unknown.

Release rights are unresolved. The code repository's custom notice applies AGPL-3.0 terms to non-commercial/academic use with separate commercial licensing, while the Hugging Face dataset cards declare MIT without analyzing upstream licenses for issues, repository code, patches, tests, logs, or derived trajectories. The five model repositories have neither model cards nor declared licenses. Privacy, consent, secret/PII scanning, malicious-code containment, and takedown handling are also not disclosed.

Contamination controls stop at an author-reported repository split: ten training repositories are said to differ from SWE-bench repositories, but the missing appendix prevents membership audit. No issue-, commit-, patch-, semantic-, clone-, solution-, generator-pretraining-, or base-model-pretraining overlap study is released. Four languages and 12 benchmark repositories, plus training models no larger than 14B, bound the experimental generalization.

公开数据对象无法对齐。仓库有 671 条 raw SweSetupBench 记录，论文描述 2,877 个已构建和 2,809 个已准备的 Python 环境，主要 trajectory dataset 有 2,809 条 messages-only 记录，而 SWE-Factory-Gym 有 430 条 task/environment 记录。没有 stable ID 或 manifest 将这些集合映射到 training subset、五个 checkpoint 或 evaluation prediction。主要 trajectory schema 也缺少 success、verifier output、reward 与 rejected record。

Verifier 同时可能出现 false negative 和语义过宽。Marker typo 与 set -e 造成 16 个报告的 false negative；反过来，crash、缺失 dependency 与 timeout 等任意 nonzero pre-patch exit 都可能满足谓词前半段。报告的 parser confusion matrix 不能证明每个 nonzero 都代表预期失败测试。由于接收阶段使用 gold patch，source linkage 与 gold-label error 也没有被独立检查。

环境复现不完整。Dockerfile 与 evaluation script 是配方，不是 immutable environment。Base-image tag 可能变化，而发布内容缺少 built image、digest-pinned base、package lock、binary-resource hash、SBOM、build log，以及把每个 episode 映射到精确 container 的全任务清单。缺失的 Appendix.pdf、不存在的 paper-run tag，以及 accepted setting 与当前 example 的漂移进一步削弱可重建性。

论文身份与引用界面存在漂移。Accepted paper 标题为 SWE Data Construction, Automatically! 并列出 Haoyu Song；较早的 arXiv/仓库引用元数据使用更长的 SWE-Factory 标题与 Yingtian Zou。Accepted PDF 仍保留 2018 ACM placeholder、dummy DOI 与 Trovato et al. 页眉。在 official proceedings record 出现之前，ACM URL、DOI、page range 与最终 BibTeX 均为 unknown。

发布权利尚未解决。代码仓库的自定义声明对 non-commercial/academic use 适用 AGPL-3.0 条款，并要求商业使用单独许可；Hugging Face dataset card 则标注 MIT，却没有分析 issue、repository code、patch、test、log 或派生 trajectory 的上游许可。五个 model repository 既没有 model card，也没有声明 license。Privacy、consent、secret/PII scan、malicious-code containment 与 takedown handling 同样未披露。

污染控制只到作者报告的 repository split：十个训练仓库据称不同于 SWE-bench 仓库，但 appendix 缺失使 membership 无法审计。发布内容没有 issue、commit、patch、semantic、clone、solution、generator-pretraining 或 base-model-pretraining overlap 分析。四种语言与 12 个 benchmark repository，以及不超过 14B 的训练模型，限定了实验泛化范围。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, SWE-Factory is a concrete blueprint for issue/PR sourcing, binary-resource repair, four-role environment generation, execution-feedback refinement, gold-patch validation, trajectory collection, and full-parameter agent SFT. A useful replication can ablate binary recovery, role separation, execution feedback, memory retrieval, and exit-code semantics while holding the same task pool and budget fixed.

The release also supplies an audit case study. Curators can compare the 671 task rows, 2,809 messages-only trajectories, and 430 Gym environments to test whether a release preserves object identity across construction stages. A stronger implementation should keep task and rollout IDs, Dockerfile and evaluation-script revisions, image digests, verifier logs, outcome labels, rejection reasons, human corrections, training subsets, and checkpoint/prediction bindings in one signed manifest.

Verifier designers can retain the standardized marker while separating assertion failures from infrastructure errors and timeouts. Human audits should publish record IDs, independent annotations, agreement and adjudication, corrected parser outcomes, and false-positive/false-negative analysis. Container builders should add digest-pinned images, dependency locks, SBOMs, resource hashes, and network/secret controls for untrusted repository execution.

Reuse class is recipe and audit reference now; training or evaluation reuse is blocked pending verification. The code, 671 tasks, 2,809 trajectories, 430 Gym rows, and checkpoints are useful starting artifacts, but users must independently resolve upstream rights, checkpoint licenses, source contamination, row lineage, trajectory success, and environment immutability. The accepted training-use boundary is SFT, agent training, and evaluation; no preference, process-reward, or RL claim should be inferred.

对“数据构建与开放发布配方”轨道而言，SWE-Factory 提供一条具体蓝图：issue/PR sourcing、binary-resource repair、四角色环境生成、execution-feedback refinement、gold-patch validation、trajectory collection 与 full-parameter agent SFT。复现实验可在固定 task pool 与 budget 下，消融 binary recovery、role separation、execution feedback、memory retrieval 与 exit-code semantics。

该发布也是一项审计案例。策展者可以对比 671 条 task、2,809 条 messages-only trajectory 与 430 条 Gym environment，检查发布是否跨构建阶段保留 object identity。更强的实现应在一个 signed manifest 中保存 task/rollout ID、Dockerfile 与 evaluation-script revision、image digest、verifier log、outcome label、rejection reason、human correction、training subset，以及 checkpoint/prediction binding。

Verifier 设计者可以保留标准 marker，同时区分 assertion failure、infrastructure error 与 timeout。人工审计应公开 record ID、独立 annotation、agreement 与 adjudication、更正后的 parser outcome，以及 false-positive/false-negative 分析。Container 构建者应为不可信仓库执行增加 digest-pinned image、dependency lock、SBOM、resource hash，以及 network/secret control。

复用等级为：当前可作为配方与审计参考；训练或评测复用在完成核验前应阻断。代码、671 条任务、2,809 条轨迹、430 条 Gym 记录与 checkpoint 都是有用起点，但使用者必须独立解决上游权利、checkpoint license、source contamination、逐行 lineage、trajectory success 与 environment immutability。Accepted training-use 边界只有 SFT、agent training 与 evaluation，不应推导 preference、process-reward 或 RL 主张。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Use the FSE 2026 accepted title and nine-author list as the paper identity; treat the older long SWE-Factory title and Yingtian Zou citation surface as version drift, and do not invent an ACM DOI.
  • The construction contract is environment-level gold-patch fail-to-pass, not step supervision: four agents produce Docker/test recipes, and the parser checks nonzero-before/zero-after exit codes.
  • Keep all counts distinct: 2,441 source issues, 671 released SweSetupBench tasks, 2,877 constructed and 2,809 prepared training environments, 2,809 messages-only trajectories, and 430 Gym rows.
  • Read the ablations and parser audit with the headline result: 337/671 at $0.047, zero binary-resource successes without download repair, 2/18/5 valid tasks without execution feedback, and 16 parser false negatives among 1,201 usable pairs.
  • Before reuse, resolve the missing Appendix, row lineage, image digests/SBOMs, model cards and licenses, upstream GitHub rights, contamination checks, security controls, and the paper/config version drift.

• 论文身份以 FSE 2026 accepted title 与九名作者为准；较早的长版 SWE-Factory 标题和 Yingtian Zou 引用界面属于版本漂移，不要虚构 ACM DOI。
  • 构建契约是 environment-level gold-patch fail-to-pass，而不是 step supervision：四个代理生成 Docker/test 配方，parser 检查 nonzero-before/zero-after exit code。
  • 必须区分所有数量：2,441 个 source issue、671 条已发布 SweSetupBench task、2,877 个已构建与 2,809 个已准备训练环境、2,809 条 messages-only trajectory，以及 430 条 Gym 记录。
  • 阅读 headline result 时同时看消融与 parser 审计：337/671、单实例 $0.047；不做 binary download repair 时相关成功数为零；移除 execution feedback 后有效任务为 2/18/5；1,201 个可用 pair 中有 16 个 parser false negative。
  • 复用前解决缺失 Appendix、逐行 lineage、image digest/SBOM、model card 与 license、上游 GitHub 权利、contamination check、security control，以及论文与配置版本漂移。
